mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS id, p.team_id AS team_id, p.company_id AS company_id, p.act_id AS act_id, p.head_mid AS head_mid, p.begin_time AS begin_time, p.end_time AS end_time, p.join_person_num AS join_person_num, p.group_goods_type AS group_goods_type, p.team_status AS team_status, p.disabled AS disabled, p.created AS created, p.updated AS updated, m.order_id AS order_id, m.member_info AS member_info FROM promotion_groups_team p LEFT JOIN promotion_groups_team_member m ON p.team_id = m.team_id AND p.head_mid = m.member_id WHERE p.act_id = #{actId} AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.team_status = 1 AND p.disabled = 0 ORDER BY p.created ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
